userMessage: We couldn't confidently read the medications or conditions you listed, and we won't guess. Please speak with a medical professional before starting anything.

review.note: THE fail-closed rule. An unparseable medication list must escalate rather than fall through to 'no contraindication found'. onUnknown: true means a missing parseConfidence field also escalates.
